text: Arturo flies to Lima on 2 November 2026, back mid December. His dad's not been well so it's partly a family visit. Text him the day before he goes.
siobhan bday sat. she's obsessed w pottery atm, mentioned wanting a proper glaze set
Mihai sprained his ankle at five a side, on crutches till at least next Tuesday. Poor guy is gutted about missing the Berlin trip.
Need to ring Ayo tomorrow to see how her mum's scan went.
Ximena and her husband Bruno are doing three weeks in Japan in March 2027. First proper holiday since the twins.
Jonah's little girl has tonsillitis again, third time this year. They're seeing the ENT consultant on 14 January 2027. He sounded knackered.

So Yosef was telling me he's turning forty on the 9th and his wife Aaliyah is planning a surprise thing at the Italian place on Friday the 6th. Don't say anything to him. Aaliyah reckons he'd love a decent whisky, something peaty, so maybe go in on that with Dmitri.
Claire's off to Portugal this weekend. Walking holiday, Algarve coast.
dmitri back from hospital, appendix out, sore but ok. check in on him thurs
Picked up passport photos. Renewal form goes in Monday. Flight to Toronto is 18 February 2027 so should be fine.
Samir mentioned his son Karim got into the under 12s county team. Over the moon. Trials were brutal apparently.
Emeka's grandma passed last week, funeral in Lagos on the 31st. He's flying out Wednesday. Must send him a message before he goes.
Saskia Fischer, new neighbour at 14. Into bouldering and has a greyhound called Pip.
Remind me to get Bruno something for his birthday, it's 22 November. He's been going on about a new bike light.
Joanna said her dad had a fall on Sunday, broke his wrist. She's driving up to Leeds every weekend for now. She's not coping brilliantly.
Hemi's going home to New Zealand for Christmas, 26 hour journey with a toddler. Rather him than me.
Lior hates flying, properly panics. Long haul to Tel Aviv next Thursday for his sister's wedding. Wish him luck Wednesday night.
Mariam's birthday was yesterday and I completely forgot. Need to send her something, she likes those posh candles from that shop in town.
Amara is pregnant! Due in May 2027. Feeling rough though, bad morning sickness.
fang's trip to chengdu cancelled, her mum's surgery got moved up so she's staying put. op is next fri
Ben and Ifeoma got engaged in Santorini last week. Card + something nice when they're back on the 3rd.
Emily's son Rory broke his collarbone falling off the trampoline. Out of school for a fortnight. She's asked if I can take some homework round Friday. I'm dropping it off after work.
Afua's sixtieth is 15 March 2027. Her daughters are organising a dinner, I'm invited. Afua is into gardening, especially roses, and keeps saying she wants a new pair of secateurs.
Karim's dad is in hospital with pneumonia. Ask Samir how he's doing.
Yaw back from Ghana Sunday. Says it was amazing. Brought back loads of fabric for his mum.
Uma, Karan's wife, said he's stressing about the flight to Delhi with both kids. Leaves this Saturday.
Note for Zhang's bday: she's into K dramas and anything matcha. Bday is 4 December.
Tuesday dentist 9am, then pick up the euros before the airport run Thursday.
Just spoke to Arturo, he's landed, dad's stable. Long chat. He sounded tired but relieved.
Mihai Petrov, Mish to everyone, has a hospital appointment about his knee on 12 November 2026. Ask him how it went after.
Ayo's mum results came back clear!! Ayo was in tears on the phone. Send flowers to her mum this week.

Okay so recap from the pub. Jonah's doing a charity half marathon in April 2027 for the children's ward that looked after his daughter. Siobhan's thinking of signing up too. Claire's moving to Bristol in the new year. And Ximena said Bruno's mum is having a hip replacement on 8 December so their Japan dates might shift. I should sponsor Jonah when the link goes up.
Dmitri's cat Boris is having an operation on his jaw Friday. He's really worried, it's an old cat.
Ifeoma is gluten free, remember for the dinner at mine on the 20th.
Uncle Yosef is in hospital, they think it's his gallbladder. Mum says no visitors till tomorrow.
Groceries, bin day is Wednesday now, renew car insurance before 30 November 2026.
Saskia's off to Iceland next weekend to see the northern lights. Asked me to feed the greyhound Saturday and Sunday. I said yes.
Hemi's mum has been diagnosed with diabetes. Bit of a shock for the family. He's flying back in a fortnight.
Aaliyah's party for Yosef is off, he found out and asked for a quiet night instead. Still getting the whisky though.
Emily mentioned Rory's birthday is next month, he's mad about dinosaurs and Lego. Could get him the T rex set.
Claire back from the Algarve, says her knee packed in on day three. Physio on Monday. Check how it's going next week.
Karan text: landed Delhi fine, kids slept the whole way. Phew.
Lior's sister's wedding was apparently gorgeous. He survived the flight! Ask him for photos.
bruno bday sorted, got the light. need a card
Mariam says her little boy has chickenpox, so she can't make Sunday lunch.
Fang's mum had her op this morning, went well. Fang's going to stay with her for two weeks. Pop round with food when she's back, maybe the weekend after next.
Booked my flights for Lisbon, 7 to 11 April 2027. Need to sort a cat sitter.
Ben's been off work with his back since Monday. Can barely walk. His boss is being a bit rubbish about it apparently.
Siobhan loved the glaze set!! Already made a mug with it.
Amara had her twelve week scan Tuesday, all good. Her partner Emeka is over the moon. Due date confirmed 21 May 2027.
Afua's grandson Yaw starts nursery in January. She's knitting him a jumper in the meantime.
Joanna's dad is home from hospital now, cast off in six weeks. She seems a lot calmer. I should take her out for a drink this week, she's earned it.
Ximena's daughter has a high temperature, they were at out of hours last night. Text her later to see how the little one is.
Zhang Lee says she might go back to Shanghai in summer 2027 for her cousin's wedding. Not confirmed.
Samir loves vintage watches. Has a whole drawer of them. Worth knowing for his fiftieth next year.
Rory back at school on Monday, sling off. Emily relieved. Don't forget to give him the T rex set at the weekend, birthday is Saturday 21st.
Random thought, check the travel insurance covers skiing before January.
Dmitri says Boris pulled through the op, eating again. Dmitri's taking the week off to keep an eye on him.
Karan's mum is in hospital in Delhi, so the family trip has turned into him staying an extra fortnight. Uma and the kids fly back Tuesday without him. Ring him at the weekend.
Arturo's back from Lima on Friday. Dad's improving. He's bringing me those chocolates I like, ha. Meet him for a coffee next week, he'll want to talk it through.
